metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1996 · Independence Day
metas.description: The aliens are coming and their goal is to invade and destroy Earth. Fighting superior technology, mankind's best weapon is the will to survive.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1998 · Armageddon
metas.description: After discovering that an asteroid the size of Texas will impact Earth in less than a month, NASA recruits a misfit team of deep-core drillers to save the planet.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1997 · The Lost World: Jurassic Park
metas.description: A research team is sent to the Jurassic Park Site B island to study the dinosaurs there, while an InGen team approaches with another agenda.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 1992 · Alien³
metas.description: Returning from LV-426, Ellen Ripley crash-lands on the maximum-security prison Fiorina 161, where she discovers that she has unwittingly brought along an unwelcome visitor.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 1997 · Alien: Resurrection
metas.description: Two centuries after her death, a powerful human/alien hybrid clone of Ellen Ripley aids a crew of space pirates in stopping the aliens from reaching Earth.

metas.name: ★ 3.8 · 1997 · Batman & Robin
metas.description: Batman and Robin try to keep their relationship together even as they must stop Mr. Freeze and Poison Ivy from freezing Gotham City.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 1996 · Mars Attacks!
metas.description: Earth is invaded by Martians with unbeatable weapons and a cruel sense of humor.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 1979 · Mad Max
metas.description: In a self-destructing world, a vengeful Australian policeman sets out to stop a violent motorcycle gang.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 1995 · Waterworld
metas.description: In a future where the polar ice-caps have melted and Earth is almost entirely submerged, a mutated mariner fights starvation and outlaw "smokers," and reluctantly helps a woman and a young girl try to find dry land.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1994 · Stargate
metas.description: An interstellar teleportation device, found in Egypt, leads to a planet with humans resembling ancient Egyptians who worship the god Ra.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1997 · Event Horizon
metas.description: A rescue crew is tasked with investigating the mysterious reappearance of a spaceship that had been lost for seven years.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 1998 · Godzilla
metas.description: French nuclear tests irradiate an iguana into a giant monster that heads off to New York City. The American military must chase the monster across the city to stop it before it reproduces.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1993 · Demolition Man
metas.description: A police officer is brought out of suspended animation in prison to pursue an old ultra-violent nemesis who is loose in a non-violent future society.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 1998 · Deep Impact
metas.description: A comet is discovered to be on a collision course with Earth. As doomsday nears, the human race prepares for the worst.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 1990 · Predator 2
metas.description: Los Angeles police hunt an alien creature in 1997.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 1984 · Dune
metas.description: A Duke's son leads desert warriors against the galactic emperor and his father's evil nemesis to free their desert world from the emperor's rule.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1987 · The Running Man
metas.description: In a future dystopian America, a wrongfully accused and convicted policeman gets his shot at freedom when he's forced to participate in a TV game show where convicts called Runners must battle killers for their freedom.

metas.name: ★ 5.0 · 1999 · Wild Wild West
metas.description: The two best special agents in the Wild West must save President Grant from the clutches of a diabolical, wheelchair-bound, steampunk-savvy, Confederate scientist bent on revenge for losing the Civil War.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 1985 · Mad Max: Beyond Thunderdome
metas.description: After being exiled from the most advanced town in post-apocalyptic Australia, a drifter travels with a group of abandoned children to rebel against the town's queen.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 1999 · Deep Blue Sea
metas.description: Searching for a cure to Alzheimer's disease, a group of scientists on an isolated research facility become the prey, as a trio of intelligent sharks fight back.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1998 · The Faculty
metas.description: When Casey Connor, Herrington High School's newspaper photographer, witnesses the murder of a nurse and sees her alive again, he decides to investigate the bizarre happenings.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1982 · Tron
metas.description: A computer hacker is abducted into a digital world and forced to participate in gladiatorial games where his only chance of escape is with the help of a heroic security program.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1999 · Bicentennial Man
metas.description: The life and times of Andrew, a robot purchased as a household appliance programmed to perform menial tasks. As Andrew begins to experience emotions and creative thought, the Martin family soon discovers they don't have an ordinar...

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 1995 · Judge Dredd
metas.description: In a dystopian future, Joseph Dredd, the most famous Judge (a police officer with instant field judiciary powers), is convicted for a crime he did not commit and must face his murderous counterpart.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 1996 · The Nutty Professor
metas.description: Grossly overweight yet good-hearted professor Sherman Klump takes a special chemical that turns him into the slim but obnoxious Buddy Love.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 1980 · Superman II
metas.description: Superman agrees to sacrifice his powers to start a relationship with Lois Lane, unaware that three Kryptonian criminals he inadvertently released are conquering Earth.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 1979 · Moonraker
metas.description: James Bond investigates the mid-air theft of a space shuttle, and discovers a plot to commit global genocide.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 1998 · Sphere
metas.description: A spaceship is discovered under three hundred years' worth of coral growth at the bottom of the ocean.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 1999 · eXistenZ
metas.description: A game designer on the run from assassins must play her latest virtual reality creation with a marketing trainee to determine if the game has been damaged.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1985 · Weird Science
metas.description: Two high-school nerds use a computer program to literally create the perfect woman, who promptly turns their lives upside-down.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 1992 · Universal Soldier
metas.description: Soldiers who were killed in action are brought back to life in a top secret military experiment that creates superhuman warriors.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 1979 · Star Trek: The Motion Picture
metas.description: When an alien spacecraft of enormous power is spotted approaching Earth, Admiral James T. Kirk resumes command of the overhauled USS Enterprise in order to intercept it.

metas.name: ★ 5.3 · 1997 · Flubber
metas.description: An absent-minded professor discovers "flubber," a rubber-like super-bouncy substance.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 1990 · RoboCop 2
metas.description: RoboCop returns to protect the citizens of old Detroit but faces a deadly challenge when a rogue OCP member secretly creates a new, evil RoboCop 2.
